title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode14 Fond Farewells

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, now that we're all here, how would you guys feel about doing another show?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why not, KAITO?!
You can show Emu and the others how to captivate an audience through sound alone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That does sound interesting...
I'd love to do a show with you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Why are you glowing all of a sudden, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps they've reached their time limit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean, time limit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, I'm not positive...
But I remember being able to return from the SEKAI created by those fragments of feelings after a certain amount of time had passed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The same thing might apply here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aw, no!
We only just met!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wish I had more time to sing with all of you. I wish I could have more of my counterpart's food. And I wish we could've done a show together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I probably would've passed on doing a show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we can do all those other things the next time you visit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. True!
And I'll be hoping that you make your dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We appreciate it. And thank you for showing us that view from on top of the wall.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
I'm sure we'll meet again...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Let's sing.
And spread hope to the entire world!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I promise! And don't worry, I'll have mastered idol songs by then, so I'll be the most adorable thing you've ever seen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's big talk!
As idols, we can't let you hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
When we do meet again, let's make as many flowers as we can in this field bloom.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe! I'll be looking forward to that day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd love to meet the others from your SEKAI next time, Len.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. That song you sang was really nice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It could be fun to play one of their songs as a band next time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'll be looking forward to doing that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
M-Me too...
I really want you girls to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, umm... Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your Len, and everyone else, are so nice... I was happy to see that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyone else would've done the same.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I am glad that I met you, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm an idol!
If you all genuinely wish to meet me again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then I'll come visit your hearts someday♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. You really are an idol.
Your aura's so dazzling!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I actually feel really encouraged.
Like I'm ready to do my best tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to make them smile from the bottoms of their hearts...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I hope that I was able to show them real empathy for even just a second. I hope that I was able to relieve some of their pain...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have to keep growing as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So that I can spread hope to anyone and everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Idol me is just so cute, and always full of hope and optimism...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure “my” feelings have reached them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When we do, I hope you'll watch me do another show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin and the others have been looking for you. We were wondering if...maybe you'd gone to another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, a Luka from another SEKAI was just here. So, we thought that the same thing had happened to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I was sent to a different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We thought so!
Did everything go okay over there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, my counterpart, as well as MEIKO and the others over there, were all very nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's nice to hear.
So, what kind of SEKAI was it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm... It was gray as far as the eye could see. It looked very empty.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it was very different from this SEKAI...
But I also felt some kindness there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also did a little show for the one whose feelings made that SEKAI, as well as her friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I was told they're dealing with problems they can't really resolve easily... So I wanted to cheer them up a little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That I need to keep growing as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep giving everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But for now, we have to find a way to survive the prelim stage of the grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep doing everything we can so that we have some good news to tell the other Luka the next time she visits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I also want to be able to make that girl and her friends smile more the next time I meet them...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to keep trying harder and harder.
